title: Characterizing successful access checks
statement: If checking a bit string $y$ against a natural number $k$ returns `some b`, then there are a bit string $z$ and a natural number $r$ such that $y$ is the encoding of $z$ paired with the binary representation of $r$, and $b$ is true exactly when $r=k$.
hypotheses_covered: The access check on $y$ against $k$ returns `some b`
